read_scope.metadata_only: AST function/class and top-level statement locations in modalities.py, common.py, tokenization.py, data.py, multimodal.py; original JSON key/type inventory; immutable original-source locator metadata. Original experiment scope strings, loss-probe strings, author summaries, prior report fields and review-dispatch content were not read.

original_chapter_filename_and_match_scan.scope: Initial original-source heading/EOS/OCR/lesson-location rg match output was read at these lines; no intervening chapter text was read except the separately recorded 11.12 and 11.13 ranges.

frozen_whole_chapter.scope: Genuine frozen input copied during this independent review and byte hash checked equal to the initial extraction source_file_sha256. This is not a claim about the current full chapter after concurrent work. Only 11.13 and necessary 11.12 context were read.

json_input.scope: All 30 rows checked, including raw token IDs, EOS stripping, exact-match booleans, decoded digit strings, family/question/target alignment to raw test records, minimum edit counts, reference character denominators and effective target-token denominator. No saved weights loaded or reevaluated.

historical_code_verification.result: git show succeeded for each; historical blob and current frozen source SHA both equal raw result /code_sha256 values. Full original files preserved without removing additional string constants.

official_source_inspections.inspection: Read bool int subclass, len length, round precision, sum accumulation and zip paired iteration/shortest-input truncation. Matches installed Python 3.13.5.
Read AssertionError behavior and optimization caveat; actual CPU checks used normal unoptimized Python.
Read string comparison by Unicode code points; scope here is ASCII digits so raw-token exact equality equals whole digit string equality.
Read CER S+D+I over N; N counts reference characters. This is a text-string metric implementation, usable for the digit OCR outputs here; no ASR capability inference.
Read per-sample summed edit operations and summed target lengths followed by errors/total. Confirms micro-aggregate CER denominator, rather than averaging each sample ratio.

Read dynamic programming initialization, diagonal equality and min(deletion,insertion,substitution)+1. AST-extracted this original function and executed it on all examples and all 30 stored predictions, independently of repository edit_distance.

Read EosTokenCriteria original docstring and implementation, stopping on final token membership in EOS IDs. It supports EOS termination semantics only; historical performance comes from the raw OCR samples.

official_source_inspections.version: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook §1.3.6.6.18, immutable fetched bytes on 2026-10-05
official_source_inspections.inspection: Read success/failure trials, fixed p and inline TeX binomial PMF. Substitution x=n=5 gives p^5. Independence is explicitly an assumption in the reviewed text and in the reviewer exact-product calculation; this page is not treated as evidence of independence in real OCR errors.

visual_inspection.reason_no_extra_figure_needed: The section compares explicitly visible digit strings and scalar counts; it does not require an unseen image, spatial arrow, axis, or label mapping. The necessary strings and denominators appear in prose and code.
visual_inspection.page_original_parity: Title, all six main paragraphs and original Python fence agree with the frozen raw source; browser DOM fence equality independently checked.
visual_inspection.desktop: 1280x800 viewport, full-page render viewed. Main prose, code, string values and CER/EOS numbers visible without zoom.
visual_inspection.mobile: 390x844 viewport, full-page render viewed. Prose readable. Long Python lines use the CODE element horizontal overflow; code-scroll inspected separately. Actual code horizontal scroll changed 0 to 195 px, and the right-side code screenshot was viewed.
visual_inspection.render_helper_first_failure: Initial paragraph-parity comparison failed because removing a fenced block left an extra leading newline in the reviewer parser. Actual paragraph text differed only by that display whitespace; helper .strip() corrected and parity/render then succeeded. Original source bytes and hashes were never normalized.

independence_record: Fresh task, solely assigned 11.13; no old 11.13 report fields read before replacing the canonical report. Repository filename search once emitted unrelated artifact path names, never their contents or verdicts. No accidental author result-summary/old conclusion exposure occurred.
scope_limits: Independent review of published definitions, original short CPU example, bounded synthetic EOS branch, and arithmetic over historical stored outputs. Does not rerun the historical CUDA training/evaluation, validate new glyphs/fonts, or establish general OCR performance.
